title: Can Occupational Therapy help my child who struggles with transitioning from different environments?
metaTitle: Supporting Transitions with Occupational Therapy - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Offering strategies to handle transitions for children with autism. Understand how our Occupational Therapy services at Pinnacle Blooms Network can provide a more seamless transition experience between different environments.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand that transitions between different environments can often be a source of stress for children with autism. Our occupational therapists can provide an array of effective strategies to help your child handle these transitions more smoothly. These might include rehearsal of transitions, gradual introduction to new settings, or use of visual aids to help your child understand and anticipate what comes next.
